data.answer:
Possibly, but the link is tentative. The 2020 report identifies a sharp fall in ICT-related design applications in 2009 and says this **“may reflect” the global financial crisis**. Its discussion covers digital products such as mobile phones and laptop computers.[1]

The decline was followed by a rapid recovery: ICT-related design applications trebled after 2009 to reach 746 in 2013.[2]

citations.quote: The sharp fall of ICT-related designs in 2009 may reflect the impact of the global financial crisis.
Competing in global markets for digital products, such as mobile phones and laptop computers

claims.text: The 2020 report tentatively links a sharp fall in ICT-related design applications in 2009 to the global financial crisis, in a discussion covering products such as mobile phones and laptops.

citations.quote: After 2009, ICT-related applications recovered quickly and trebled to 746 in 2013

claims.text: ICT-related design applications recovered quickly after 2009 and trebled to 746 in 2013.
